youtube_title: Neon Drift: The Mars Rovers ML Grand Prix (Real-Time AI Model Race)
youtube_description:
Welcome to Neon Drift—where competing ML systems race to control next-gen Mars rovers. Each model must rapidly predict safe routes, avoid hazards, handle dust-storm uncertainty, and optimize rover energy in real time.

In this episode you’ll see: 
• Live “model telemetry” as the race unfolds
• How each competitor handles terrain + visibility changes
• The metrics that decide the winner (safety, path efficiency, energy cost)

Cast your vote in the comments and follow for the next race.
